name: FDK Backprojection Transpose (Adjoint)
definition: The adjoint (transpose) of the FDK backprojection. It scatters voxel values from the volume back to the projection panels using the same geometric mapping and weights, accumulating into projection buffers using atomicAdd.
summary: The FDK Backprojection Transpose computes the adjoint of the forward FDK projection by scattering voxel values into 2D projection panels using atomic accumulation, serving as the transpose of the linear system matrix.
